POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES

Sarah Bedy, Member  Julie Lie, Member
Doug Killion, Member  Leanna Noble, Member
  Patricia Scott, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Sarah Bedy, called the meeting to order at 2:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Bedy, Killion, Lie, Noble, Scott

Also present: Jennifer Santana, Secretary, Paul Duncan, Homeless Services Bureau Manager.

Roll call taken by Jennifer Santana.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-57309  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Policy Subcommittee Meeting of
  Monday, November 10, 2025.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Lie, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Scott, Noble, Lie, Killion, Bedy
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

2.  25-57307  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on follow-up to the 2025
  Homeless Services Advisory Committee (HSAC) Policy Recommendations to the
  Mayor and City Council.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5 Scott, Noble, Lie, Killion, Bedy
  No:  0 None

  Page 1 of 4
   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, JANUARY 12, 2026
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810

  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 0 None

  • Subcommittee members discussed the policy recommendations and shared
  conversations they have had with their respective council members.
  • Additional discussion on this topic will take place during the full HSAC
  meeting.
  • Members expressed enthusiasm about receiving feedback from their council
  members.
  • Members discussed the mobile shower system that has been approved by
  city council, the subcommittee is looking to find more information on how
  these showers will operate.

3.  26-57358  Receive and file a discussion on cost-effective homeless service models.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Scott, Noble, Lie, Killion, Bedy
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • Members and staff discussed the request for a presentation regarding cost-
  effective homeless model services.
  • Staff and Members discuss the pros and cons regarding drop in centers.
  • Members of the subcommittee expressed a desire to provide a safe space
  for unhoused individuals to access basic services on a day-to-day basis.

4.  25-57310  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on making a project funding
  recommendation to the Mayor's Fund.

  A motion was made by Voting Member Noble, seconded by Member Lie, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5 Killion, Lie, Noble, Scott, Bedy
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None

  Page 2 of 4
   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, JANUARY 12, 2026
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM

  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 0 None

  • Members and staff discussed the opportunity for the Mayor’s Fund to support
  a pilot program that could include mobile showers and restrooms.
  • Bureau Manager Paul Duncan provided funding updates for the bureau. At
  this time, there are several uncertainties regarding funding for the upcoming
  year.
  • Staff suggest that the subcommittee brings this up to the larger committee
  for approval first before requesting approval from the Mayor’s office for the
  pilot program.
  • Members also discussed concerns about the longevity of the pilot program if
  the requested funding amount is high and unable to sustain the program
  beyond one year. The subcommittee will consider a pilot program that
  requires less funding and may be replenished beyond the first year.

5.  25-57311  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion of future agenda items.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Bedy, Killion, Lie, Noble, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • The subcommittee will continue to discuss item number four.

PUBLIC COMMENT

  • No public comment.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

  • No announcements.
